facts.query: What is the history of Yoru?
facts.subject: Yoru/History
expected: Yoru had presumably previously fought alongside the Four Horsemen and the Weapon Devils against Pochita in Hell.(Chapter 87) During their battles, Chainsaw Man had eaten the World War II, Nazi, and Nuclear Weapons Devils along with parts of Yoru's body, severely weakening her.(Chapter 84) Because of this, there hasn't been a single war since "the world war" which further diminished her strength.
found: Yoru had presumably previously fought alongside the Four Horsemen and the Weapon Devils against Pochita in Hell.(Chapter 87) During their battles, Chainsaw Man had eaten the World War II, Nazi, and Nuclear Weapons Devils along with parts of Yoru's body, severely weakening her.(Chapter 84) Because of this, there hasn't been a single war since "the world war" which further diminished her strength.
